plan.notes: Source: official FSU Academic Program Guide, Academic Map for Computer Science, BS (Effective Summer 2026 and after), transcribed term-by-term from the map's Sample Schedule on 2026-09-30: https://academic-guide.fsu.edu/academic-map/Computer Science, BS . Degree/program name verified against the University Registrar's Undergraduate Department of Computer Science bulletin (registrar.fsu.edu), which offers the Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, accredited by the Computing Accreditation Commission of ABET. Catalog year 2026-2027 (current catalog at time of transcription). All course codes, titles, and credits are verbatim from the official map. Caveats: (1) The map is explicitly a 'term-by-term sample course schedule' and 'general guideline' -- GE and elective courses must be selected to satisfy all area requirements, so specific student choices will vary. (2) The transcribed sample sums to 116 credits; the degree requires a minimum of 120 total hours. The remaining hours come from the student's own GE/elective selections per the map's instructions and were NOT invented here. (3) COP 3353 (1 cr) is conditional: taken only if COP 3014 is chosen instead of COP 3363; on the COP 3363 path the sample sums to 115. (4) The summer GE Natural Science (for Majors) is listed as 3/4 credits; modeled at 3 with a note. (5) The map does not list per-course prerequisites, so all prereq arrays are empty rather than invented. (6) Map milestones (C- or better in ENC1101, MAC2311, MAC2312, COP 3014/COP 3363, MAD 2104, COP 3330, CDA 3100, COP 4530; 2.50 retention GPA) are progression requirements, not courses. (7) The program guide additionally permits STA 4321 or STA 3032 in place of STA 4442; the Academic Map lists STA 4442.
